evidence.quoted_text:
require(payload["cli"]["rc"] not in (0, None),
            "interrupted recovery unexpectedly returned success")
evidence.reason: The recover-kill check at current lines 1342-1343 accepts any nonzero/None exit status, so a normal recover failure that exits before the drain kill hook can leave the retained record unchanged and still satisfy the subsequent unchanged-record and drained-intent assertions. That lets the test report an interrupted recovery without exercising the expected SIGKILL termination (rc -9). This is a concrete test-oracle gap in existing intended behavior; the exact-status predicate is the smallest compatible repair.
